docs.summary: Hot reload lifecycle hooks for a type whose instances are replaced. Tear down engine registrations (physics bodies, event subscriptions, native handles) in [`OnReloadDetach`](#api~Prowl.Ember.IReloadAware~OnReloadDetach) on the outgoing instance and re-establish them in [`OnReloadAttach`](#api~Prowl.Ember.IReloadAware~OnReloadAttach) on the incoming one.

Runs on the outgoing instance once its state has been read, while the previous graph is still intact. Values written to `state` are migrated before they reach [`OnReloadAttach`](#api~Prowl.Ember.IReloadAware~OnReloadAttach).
Runs on the incoming instance after every root has been committed, so the whole graph is consistent.
